name: ModelVariant662_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant662_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a rippling tube of strips reaching from in front of the slot to a tracked model point, a dome of strips at the point, and, once the tube is fully grown, a widening cone of strips and eight camera-facing animated sparks around it); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-679 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant679_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
